raw_text: All traffic signals in Pune have been going haywire since early morning. Green lights in all directions at major intersections. Smart streetlights turning on and off randomly. Multiple accidents reported at Swargate, Hinjewadi, and Katraj junctions. Rumors of a cyber attack on Pune Smart City IoT systems. PMC has not issued any statement yet.
clean_text: Pune traffic signals and streetlights malfunctioning citywide. Accidents at Swargate, Hinjewadi, and Katraj. Rumors of cyber attack on smart city IoT systems.
